title: Get FASTER  ON iRacing OVALS! | iRacing Track Guide | Iowa | NASCAR GEN 6

notes.exit: get back on gas once car rotates
notes.mistakes: get back on gas too soon, hit wall
notes.text: braking: drag brakes, rotate nose; line: point nose toward yellow line; exit: get back on gas once car rotates; mistakes: get back on gas too soon, hit wall
notes.snippet: toward the yellow line get back on the gas once you feel the car begin to rotate around the second pit exit line

notes.exit: ease back on throttle once car hooks up
notes.text: line: position wide, take similar arc; exit: ease back on throttle once car hooks up
notes.snippet: and take a similar Arc and turns three and four gently drag your brakes aim with the yellow line with your left

notes.text: braking: drag brakes for moment; line: arc down half a lane; exit: build momentum
notes.snippet: four drag the brakes for a moment to rotate the nose and Arc down half a lane to build as much momentum as you can now

notes.braking: avoid massive bumps on the outside
notes.text: braking: avoid massive bumps on the outside; line: stay below dotted white line; exit: avoid overdriving, back up entries; mistakes: overshooting corners, squaring off exits
notes.snippet: also have a few massive bumps on the outside of turn one so you want to avoid those at all costs they'll upset the car

notes.exit: every lane fair game, use outside line sparingly
notes.mistakes: overdriving corners, failing to back up entries
notes.text: line: roll center of corners; exit: every lane fair game, use outside line sparingly; mistakes: overdriving corners, failing to back up entries
notes.snippet: that outside line sparingly it pays off if you use it properly but if you find yourself overdriving corners and failing
